text:
sara (PM): Quick heads-up — ACME needs a deterministic rollout plan for eval-triggered alerts + quant recs. They want tenant-level opt-in and a staged release by tier.

miguel (CS): Yes, they asked for hard stop notifications when eval regressions exceed 5% on critical prompts. Also wants per-tenant scoring so internal SREs can triage.

anika (ML): We can compute delta on the eval corpus weekly. Need to define what 'regression' means: AUC drop? ROUGE? propose: default = avg prompt concordance drop >= 5% p95.

kai (Eng): Implementation notes: system-level alerts + tenant-level webhooks. Suggest rollout flags: 
```
{
  "phase": "canary",
  "tenants": ["internal", "alpha"],
  "metrics": ["concordance_p95"],
  "threshold": 0.05
}
```
Can support per-tenant toggles in the next sprint.

sara (PM): Nice. We also need quantization recommendations to be surfaced alongside alerts — e.g., when cost/latency tradeoffs suggest moving to int8, but only if quality delta < 1%. How should that be scored?

anika (ML): Score = weighted sum of (quality_delta * 100) + (latency_improvement * 0.5) + (cost_savings * 0.2). Threshold for recommending a quant profile: score <= 1.0. We can tune weights after pilot.

kai (Eng): Ops question: if we auto-suggest quant profiles, do we allow automated rollouts or just recommendations + human approval? My vote: recommendations only for GA; canary automated on Dedicated later.

miguel (CS): For customers like ACME, they want an 'apply recommendation' API so they can programmatically opt-in. So expose a signed webhook and audit trail.

sara (PM): Launch criteria (proposal):
- Pilot: internal + 3 alpha customers, no automated apply.
- Success metrics: alert precision >= 80%, false positives < 10% for top-50 prompts.
- Quant rec accuracy: when customers apply recs, quality delta < 1% in 90% of cases.

kai (Eng): Risks: cost of storing per-tenant eval histories (~100GB/month at scale), and burst alerting can overload paging. Need SLOs on alert delivery.

anika (ML): Action items for ML: define eval signal taxonomy (concordance, hallucination score, latency-regression), create baseline weights, run sims on 6 recent customers.

miguel (CS): Action items for CS: recruit 2 alpha customers (ACME + 1) and obtain consent for tenant eval data.

sara (PM): Roadmap placement: ship pilot in sprint 6 (approx 6 weeks). If we hit acceptance, GA in 3 sprints. Everyone ok with that cadence?

kai (Eng): Ack — will scope work into two epics: alert infra + recommendation UI/API.

anika (ML): Acknowledged. I'll post simulation results by EOW.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag scaffolding created on branch feat/eval-alerts (CI job kicked). :rocket:

sara (PM): Perfect — I'll consolidate this into a short PRD and tag owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
